summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) filed a Form 6-K containing the minutes of its Extraordinary General Meeting held August 18, 2026. Shareholders representing 95.85% of voting capital fixed the Board of Directors at thirteen members and elected two new directors for a supplementary term until the 2027 AGM. The meeting was routine corporate governance, with no special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, tender offer, or strategic review. No deal terms, premium, or advisors were mentioned. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report of an ordinary EGM outcome, thus not a special situation.
